extracted.name: Chicken Stew
instruction_lines: Marinate chicken with soy sauce and rub with flour
Fry chicken wings until they turn braun
Chop tomatoes, onion and carrots and fry on a medium heat pan
Add ketchup and 1 cup of water or light chicken stock
Cook on medium heat for 20-25 minutes
Serve and enjoy with your favorite pasta
